therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: post-operative patients with nausea or vomiting in the post anesthetic care unit

dose_info.schedule: up to 3 minutes bilateral wrist pressure for acupressure; as needed for ondansetron

context.duration: time to discharge from post anesthetic care unit
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated due to recruitment futility.
